Welcome back ramp crew,
The ramp crew mentioned an idea about cabin readiness after lunch

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned with the same steady handling approach we use on the ramp. When a case comes in, confirm the booking notes, the animal's profile, and any crate or carrier details before you pass it forward. If a traveler raises a concern, keep the tone calm and move through the review steps in order so we avoid confusion at the counter and on the aircraft.

For the current open cases, apply the usual checks for documentation, routing, and acceptance limits. <<FACT F060>> If there is any mismatch between the records and the handoff notes, send it back for review rather than trying to resolve it informally. Keep the communication clear and brief so the next team can act without delay.

Also, remember that every animal arriving through Aurelia Skyways should be handled with care from booking through pickup. <<FACT F079>> Use the same standard when you speak with the traveler, the handler, or the gate team, and document any exception in plain language. If a case needs escalation, move it through the calm stepwise review and keep the file updated until the matter is closed.

Thank you for keeping the desk organized and consistent.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
